scripts.dev: npm run build -w @latex-free/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web 'npm run dev -w @latex-free/api' 'npm run dev -w @latex-free/web'
scripts.build: npm run build -w @latex-free/shared && npm run build -w @latex-free/api && npm run build -w @latex-free/compiler && npm run build -w @latex-free/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @latex-free/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @latex-free/shared && npm run test:integration -w @latex-free/api
